# Galaxy Movies

> Decision-first streaming guide: helps you pick what to watch tonight, filtered to the services you actually have. No account required — watchlists and ratings save to your device, and email alerts confirm with one click. Covers US and India catalogs.

## Key pages

- / — trending titles, your-services filter, AI assistant (Galaxy Bot) for "what should I watch" questions
- /new-on-streaming — arrivals and announced releases per service, updated daily
- /leaving — dated departures per service
- /this-month — monthly arrivals-vs-departures verdict per service
- /reports/streaming-churn — monthly churn report: net catalog change per provider
- /free — movies and shows streaming free with ads
- /streaming — per-service catalog browsing
- /genre/* — genre browsing for movies and TV
- /lists — curated lists; /collections — franchise collections
- /movie-night — merge two taste profiles for a two-person pick
- /widgets — embeddable "new & leaving" iframes and churn stat card
- /justwatch-alternative, /reelgood-alternative — comparison pages

## Open data & feeds

- GET /api/streaming-changes?provider={key|all} — daily catalog diffs as JSON (CORS *, 120 req/hr, no key)
- /embed/{provider} — iframe widget of arrivals/departures (?theme=light)
- /embed/churn — iframe monthly churn stat card
- /api/cal/{provider} — public ICS calendar of announced arrivals and departures per service
- /leaving.xml — RSS feed of recent departures

## Data notes

- Watch-provider data: TMDB; rental/purchase prices and provider deep links: Watchmode (US).
- Catalog-change history is accumulated daily and is the site's proprietary dataset; departure dates mark detection day, announced "leaving soon" dates can shift.
- No user accounts: preference data lives client-side; alert subscriptions are token-keyed.
